title: 10% off Nintendo eShop, Google Play, Dymocks, Event & Village Cinema Gift Cards (EDR Required, in-Store Only) @ Woolworths
body:
Deal: 10% off Nintendo eShop, Google Play, Dymocks, Event & Village Cinema Gift Cards (EDR Required, in-Store Only) @ Woolworths

[kerfuffle] Dropbox, YouTube Premium, FlightRadar24, Weatherzone, Pokémon Go, Google One …
[HLTT] Any tampering issue with nintendo eshop cards?
[ronnknee] Ugh, just stocked up on Google Play from Coles. Rather actual discount than FlyBuys points.
[daanish] I nearly did the same but I was holding out until the Woolworths catalogue preview dropped on Monday in case a pure 10% offer came up. Looks like the HODL has paid off this time.
[kaleidoscope] Feels like these are traps to drive up consumption and inflation and reason for RBA to drive up rates 😁
